[ASSISTANT_SAID] Butternut squash soup is a perfect choice for a cozy weekend meal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for butternut squash soup include: 1 large butternut squash (about 2-3 lbs), 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 onion (chopped), 3 cloves of garlic (minced), 1 teaspoon of ground cumin, 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika (optional), salt and pepper (to taste), 4 cups of chicken or vegetable broth, 1/2 cup of heavy cream or coconut cream (optional), fresh herbs like parsley, sage, or thyme for garnish (optional), nutmeg (to taste), cinnamon (to taste), ground ginger (to taste, optional), water (for roasting the squash), stockpot or large Dutch oven, immersion blender or regular blender (for pureeing the soup).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can adjust the amount of spices and seasonings to their liking and add other ingredients to customize the soup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Some people like to add a splash of apple cider or a pinch of cayenne pepper for extra flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It's comforting to have a bowl of hot soup on a chilly day.  
[EVENT] User is thinking of making apple cider donuts to go with the soup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A simple recipe for apple cider donuts includes: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup whole milk, 2 teaspoons active dry yeast, 1/4 teaspoon salt, 2 large eggs, 2 tablespoons unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 cup apple cider (chilled), 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, confectioners' sugar (for dusting, optional), cinnamon sugar (for coating, optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for apple cider donuts include mixing dry and wet ingredients, letting the dough rise, frying the donuts, and dusting with sugar.
